readme: Opt-in git-work policy — NEVER auto-applied, and NOT loaded by a bare `policy
adopt-defaults` either: nothing here loads until you adopt THIS file by name:
unjangled-guardrails policy adopt-defaults examples/user-policy.git-work.json
(from the checkout root; on hosts without the bin: node <plugin-root>/src/cli.js
policy adopt-defaults <plugin-root>/examples/user-policy.git-work.json).
What it carries (operator rulings 2026-11-09): the two push entries that left
the suggested defaults (ruling 2a), and commit allows scoped to YOUR projects
folder (ruling 3) — the subagent mitigation, matching the folder the tool call
actually runs in (workdir-resolved project scope). A command allow lifts asks
AND brain denies for its shapes: adopt this only if you vouch for pushes and
in-folder commits on this install. Force and +refspec pushes still die at the
Always-Deny layer regardless.
PLACEHOLDER: the project:~/projects scope is a GENERIC EXAMPLE, never a real
path — this file is tracked and must carry no real operator path. Scope matching
is literal-prefix on the call's working directory, so the unedited placeholder
matches nothing, which is the safe direction. Substitute your absolute projects
folder (e.g. project:/home/you/projects or project:/Users/you/projects) in this
file before adopting, or fix the entries afterwards with policy remove +
policy add --effect allow --pattern 'git add *' --scope project:/your/abs/path.
Already adopted the pre-rework defaults? Adoption is additive and never
deletes: remove the moved entries by hand if you do not want them
(policy remove <id | pattern>).
